# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't** open a public issue. Report it privately instead:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/phpandrew/Plots/security/advisories/new)

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version of Plots you're running (Settings › About). You'll get a reply as soon as possible, and a fix goes out as a normal release, which Plots offers through its built-in update check.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets fixes. Plots updates itself, so staying current is one click.

## How releases are checked

Every release is scanned with govulncheck and CodeQL before it's published. See [docs/SECURITY-FLOW.md](../docs/SECURITY-FLOW.md).
